trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document) WHERE CAST(p.draft_pick AS INT64) = 24 AND CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) < 1 RETURN CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) AS col1, p.position AS col2, p.birth_date AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document) WHERE p.draft_pick CONTAINS '24' AND (p.olympic_gold_medals = '0' OR p.olympic_gold_medals IS NULL) RETURN CASE WHEN p.olympic_gold_medals IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) END AS col1, p.position AS col2, p.birth_date AS col3, p.name AS name_player
